name: a well-formed identifier nobody registered is not found [api]
rationale: A conformant identifier that was never registered is absent, not malformed. Saying invalid here would send an implementer to check their string instead of their registration.

expected_history.why: Until moltrust-api #741 (2026-10-12) the API carried its code under detail.error. A miss is now a DID resolution result with an RFC 9457 error object, as section 4.4 of DID Resolution v1 requires. detail.error still answers did_not_found until 2027-01-10, but this vector reads the form the specification names.
